label: 2 m
notes: 2 m half of a VHF/UHF LEO satellite pair. RHCP, crossed loops fed by a turnstile harness (a Q-section per loop, delay line in loop B's leg, 1:1 current choke), with a drooping radial reflector to favor high-elevation passes. Round tubing. Targets: axial ratio < 3 dB over the coverage cone, VSWR < 1.5 after matching. Reflector count, spacing, and droop left for the optimizer.
